title: HYDRAA starts Fox Sagar revamp to lift storage 4x

slides.head: HYDRAA starts Fox Sagar revamp to lift storage 4x
What happened
slides.body: Works include desilting, treating polluted water, strengthening the bund, inlets and outlets, a sewage treatment plant and a ring bund, per The Hindu.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Sewage and industrial chemical waste left nearly five metres of silt, blocking water from percolating into the ground, Commissioner A.V. Ranganath said.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Fox Sagar was built in 1897 under the Nizam and once supplied Secunderabad's drinking water.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether the water-storage works finish before the next monsoon, as HYDRAA aims. Ask: How will NEERI's before-and-after tests be shared with residents?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
HYDRAA starts Fox Sagar revamp to lift storage 4x

HYDRAA launched restoration of the 1897 Fox Sagar lake in Jeedimetla on Friday, aiming to turn it into a mini reservoir and mini Tank Bund within a year.

Why it matters: Sewage and industrial chemical waste left nearly five metres of silt, blocking water from percolating into the ground, Commissioner A.V. Ranganath said.

Source: The Hindu. Image: The Hindu
